status: Exploratory addition after observing 224-pixel results and before 320-pixel test evaluation
question: How sensitive is the architecture/resolution choice to resampling the available model-selection groups?
method: Jointly resample filename-derived selection groups with replacement 1000 times, random seed 42. For each fixed architecture/resolution candidate, calculate mean AUROC across its three fixed seed models. Record the maximum with the unchanged lower-resolution/alphabetical tie rule.
selection_policy: Descriptive only. Do not replace the original full-development-sample choice or tune any model, threshold or temperature.
data: Only selection predictions and development manifest/configuration checks; no test scores used.
reporting: Report winner counts/fractions, tied-maximum count and percentile ranges of resampled mean selection AUROC for all six candidates, including zero-win candidates.
limitations: Winner frequencies are not posterior probabilities or estimates of external superiority
The same partition selected checkpoints, so selection optimism remains
Fixed-model conditional analysis: training and checkpoint selection are not repeated
Filename-derived groups are unverified patient proxies
Protocol addition is exploratory, not a prespecified primary endpoint
